entry_state: The rate enclosure follows one shared original rate through the whole loan. Modified terms, recovered credit and reversal of SICR remain separate findings. Collateral cash after maturity stays in loss measurement and accounting write-off does not waive legal rights. Revolving capacity, integral and service fees, eligible partial sales and continuing guarantees have now been distinguished; option-based transfer exposures follow next.
exit_state: Chapter 11 closes by separating retained option rights, their associated liabilities and asset measurement bases. Funding capacity, draw request, confirmed settlement and an uncertain acknowledgement remain distinct. Bank behavior and regulatory assessment need their own facts and evidence; the next chapter examines insurance service, finance and claims.
findings: The call, put and collar cases reconstruct retained economic exposure from separately recognised assets and liabilities rather than adding a duplicate option.
Amortised-cost transfer accounting uses distinct asset and liability yields.
Three funding outcomes preserve unpaid deposits without adding the same liability again; timeout does not prove nonreceipt. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
